notModeled.why: PA requirements are MCO policy within UMCM limits; load them as prior-auth rules per plan, not as benefit flags.
MCO-specific extras (for example adult dental, gift cards, extra vision) approved by HHSC per contract; not a state benefit.
Outpatient drugs follow the state Vendor Drug Program formulary and preferred drug list; CHO has no formulary resolution yet (capability 5.14).
Respite, flexible family support, adaptive aids, minor home modifications and similar waiver services follow an individual service plan; no CHO category.
